stage: metadata qualification and parent-material planning only
research_question: Locate common Linux consumers whose architecture-conditioned guarantees and first-use requirements can be examined in a separately registered source experiment.
registration_order: Written before collecting or inspecting changed-path metadata for this round. Previous e-round four candidate metadata and f-round auxiliary source are already known.
ranking: Exclude unavailable commits, commits without exactly one parent, confirmed source/development reads, explicitly known repair families, and explicitly deferred prior candidates.
Require an exact changed-path intersection with the queue; implementation priority 0, headers priority 1.
Sort by priority, then SHA256(seed + ':' + full_commit_hash), then full_commit_hash.
Select at most one per queue in listed order, skipping already selected hashes. No quota transfer, empty-queue expansion, or replacements after postselection review.

explicit_prior_exclusions.9e9af8bbb5f9b565b9faf691f96f661791e199b0: previously deferred family-suspicion candidate; not automatically resumed

exposure_audit.allowed: Existing case_taxonomy md/tsv and JSON named protocol/selection/metadata, old registered exposure indexes. Extract identities, contact paths and explicit prior source/development/family evidence only.
exposure_audit.not_found_means: No evidence found in the bounded audit; global unseen status is unknown.
exposure_audit.screening_contact: All 500 have earlier DeepSeek screening contact, so none are globally model-unseen.
exposure_audit.metadata_only: A hash or subject in a pool, selected list or protocol is not source-reading evidence and is not itself excluded.
exposure_audit.family: Use explicit existing repair-family evidence. Same author alone does not establish a family. A suspicious same-author/same-topic/shared-path selected pair is isolated to at most one pending later source evidence.
exposure_audit.postselection: If new read/family evidence is found, isolate that item without replacement. Missing evidence is not independence proof. Record any accidental model-label exposure and never use it to rank or infer truth.

fields: existing manifest subject/band/stratum as identity tags only
metadata_collection.rename_policy: Disable rename detection. Preserve deletion and addition paths separately; no inference of unchanged or moved functions.
metadata_collection.errors: Preserve missing objects and Git failures; do not fetch, substitute, choose merge parents or retry to get a favourable result.

meaning_of_selection: Changed paths are research-location priorities, not relevance truth or a global screening rejection. Architecture-only repairs can be valid; neither two architecture names nor simultaneous arch/public edits are required. Titles, original model labels, band and stratum do not determine ranking or truth.
parent_plan_requirements: Exact single parent and changed public paths
Bounded same-version source lookup for actual public consumer and architecture provider
Same-purpose legal configurations and authority still to establish
Distinguish target qualification, object, readiness and first actual content use
Record the next opaque boundary rather than recursively expanding helpers
not_allowed_this_stage: old assessment or raw model-answer reads
calling a candidate positive or normal from metadata
exit: Save all-pool metadata, deterministic selection and exposure/family status, exact parent-material plan, independent method review, and current checkpoint. Source qualification is a separate next task; no new formal independent positive/normal denominator in this stage.
